description: Fetch one template by its path (as returned by list_templates) and get its full prompt text when the licence allows it. Use this after list_templates when the user wants to actually apply, compare or quote a specific template. Free/MIT templates return the complete text; restricted-licence ones return metadata plus the original repo link only.

path.description: 模板路径，例如 marketing/aeo-specialist（来自 list_templates 的 path 字段）

name: get_template
